public TaskInfo prepareTaskInfo(String taskName, double cpu, double mem) {
    TaskID taskId = TaskID.newBuilder()
                            .setValue(taskName)
                            .build();

    Resource cpuResource = Resource.newBuilder()
                                 .setName("cpus")
                                 .setType(Value.Type.SCALAR)
                                 .setScalar(Value.Scalar.newBuilder()
                                         .setValue(cpu))
                                 .build();

    Resource memResource = Resource.newBuilder()
                                 .setName("mem")
                                 .setType(Value.Type.SCALAR)
                                 .setScalar(Value.Scalar.newBuilder()
                                         .setValue(mem))
                                 .build();

    TaskInfo task = TaskInfo.newBuilder()
                               .setTaskId(taskId)
                               .setName(taskName)
                               .addResources(cpuResource)
                               .addResources(memResource)
                               .build();

    return task;
}

<T> T access(CallInfo callInfo, Access<T> op) {
    try {
      return op.execute();
    }
    catch (SQLException e) {
      if (isEnabled(DB.Option.LOG_DATABASE_EXCEPTIONS)) {
        log.write(callInfo, e);
      }
      throw new DBExecutionException(e); 
    }
